method: Static NavigationObstacle3D bake exclusions. No post-bake centroid deletion, manual clipping, runtime script or collision change. Every outline encloses canonical footprint and live visual roof XZ bounds with0.1m margin; globalY=live ceiling minus0.1m; top=live roof maximum plus0.2m. Y extrusion preserves all authored floors/stair treads below the roof.
coordinate_test_for_native_audit: For world vertex(x,y,z), dx=x-rootX,dz=z-rootZ; localX=cos(yaw)*dx-sin(yaw)*dz; localZ=sin(yaw)*dx+cos(yaw)*dz. Compare localXZ with exclusion_local_bounds_xz_m and worldY with[min_y_world_m,max_y_world_m]. Use this to report bake residue only, never delete polygons by centroid.
conventions: Existing editable template ceiling ConcavePolygonShape3D is downward one-sided with backface_collision=false, layer1; visual roofs have no explicit collider in those templates. Thin wall-top faces may still enter a static-collider bake.

Imported metal roof wrapper has no collision properties and GLB contains no collision-helper nodes. Its POSITION accessor bounds, identity GLB node transforms and live wrapper placement/yaw are used for exact roof bounds.
Pending primitives are closed BoxShape3D solids. B04 floor/walls/lintel/roof are closed boxes. Native exclusions suppress rooftop navigation independently of physical closure.

limits: No native bake/import/editor/runtime performed by this worker. Primary must verify that parser includes these obstacle nodes and carve removes all roof polygons.

Native voxel/edge/polygon simplification still affects carve boundaries. Any residual/straddling roof polygons require reported native geometry and a deliberate follow-up; centroid-only filtering is rejected because it can create holes or delete unrelated surfaces.
